title: Ketef Hinnom Silver Scrolls
summary: Two tiny silver scrolls inscribed with a form of the priestly blessing.
historical_context: Among the oldest known Hebrew textual witnesses linked to the Bible.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: An important witness to early biblical text tradition and blessing language.
covenantal_significance: Ketef Hinnom Silver Scrolls helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: The texts are secure, but they are fragmentary and require careful epigraphic reconstruction.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
